title: Sweep: gitignore staging sweep (14 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Staging/gitignore hygiene: prescriptions about phase-stub shape rules, untracking regenerated coverage artifacts, and what may ride the shipping index. This theme CAUSED wave-3 cycle-1572 and 1574 rejections. Amortised from 14 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.

prescriptions.text: PRESCRIPTION: Stage go/cmd/evolve/cmd_salvage_amplify_test.go, go/internal/deliverable/classify_bad_verdict_amplify_test.go and go/internal/deliverable/salvage_report_amplify_test.go explicitly before ship — they are untracked and not gitignored (git check-ignore rc=1), so the ship will silently land without the test-amplification phase's work
PRESCRIPTION: Add a gate reconciling git status against triage-decision.json:top_n[].files so a pre-staged worktree artifact cannot enter a cycle commit unscoped

PRESCRIPTION: Re-read the full staged set with git status --porcelain before writing the build-report tracking attestation, and distinguish inherited continuation paths from builder-authored ones by name

PRESCRIPTION: Delete go/acs/cycle1493/test_amplification_test.go or unanchor its inner regex to -run 'TestC1493_00[12]' to match the eval's own commands, then re-run go test -count=1 ./acs/cycle1493 before any ship — leaving it untracked is not a safeguard because shipDirect runs git add -A

PRESCRIPTION: Untracked delivered test go/internal/fleet/test_amplification_test.go is not gitignored but is not staged - run git add -f go/internal/fleet/test_amplification_test.go or the ship will silently drop the amplification coverage

PRESCRIPTION: Quarantine the bug-reproduction reproducer outside the worktree, or make ship refuse an untracked failing *_test.go, before any manual landing is taken from worktree cycle-42824668-1538.
